description.en: Rams, Vignelli, Bass, Scher, Carson — graphic design critique across 7 masters
description.zh: Rams、Vignelli、Bass 等7位大师联合评审你的设计

outcome.en: Run your visual design past seven graphic design masters — Dieter Rams on function, Vignelli on grid, Saul Bass on concept, and more.
outcome.zh: 让七位平面设计大师评审你的视觉设计——Dieter Rams 谈功能，Vignelli 谈网格，Saul Bass 谈概念。

reason.en: Seven masters in one skill: Rams (less is more), Vignelli (grid systems), Bass (concept), Scher (typography), Brockmann, Carson, and Rand.
reason.zh: 七位大师合一：Rams（少即是多）、Vignelli（网格系统）、Bass（概念）、Scher（排版）、Brockmann、Carson、Rand。
